ValidationRule.description: Prevents users, that don't have permission, changing status from 'Daon Failed' to either 'Equifax Failed/Passed' or 'Confirm Fraud' and from 'ID Ops: Daon Approved' to either 'Equifax Failed/Passed' or 'Failed (OK)', 'Potential Fraud' or 'Confirm Fraud'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), NOT( $Permission.ANZx_Edit_COB_Case_Status ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance", OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Daon Failed"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Failed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Passed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Confirmed Fraud" ) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "ID Ops: Daon Approved"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Failed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Passed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Failed (OK)" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Potential Fraud" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Confirmed Fraud" ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status from 'Daon Failed' to 'Equifax Failed', 'Equifax Passed' or 'Confirmed Fraud' and from 'ID Ops: Daon Approved' to 'Equifax Failed', 'Equifax Passed', 'Failed (OK)', 'Potential Fraud' or 'Confirmed Fraud'.
